requirement_text: Fixture manager can preview.
Manager permission is restaurant scoped.
Unknown restaurant receives 404 not_found.
Unknown table receives 404 not_found.
A table outside this restaurant receives 404 not_found.
Require from strictly before to as exact absolute instants.
Input instants must have explicit offsets.
Proposed closure is half open.
Consider every overlapping confirmed booking, including a booking not seated on the closing table.
Cancelled bookings are not considered.
Other restaurants are excluded.
An end equal to closure start is excluded.
A start equal to closure end is excluded.
Nonconsidered bookings keep their assignments.
Each option uses that booking own accepted capacities.
Latest publication cannot replace a booking accepted capacities.
Options are singles and declared pairs only.
Undeclared or transitive pairs are never assigned.
Options cannot conflict with fixed bookings.
Options cannot conflict with another resulting assignment.
Options cannot intersect earlier applied closures.
Options cannot intersect the proposed closure.
All conflicts use half-open absolute instants.
Diner cutoff does not prohibit a manager repair.
Every reference remains.
Every owner remains.
Every party size remains.
Every start remains.
Every end remains.
Every complete accepted snapshot remains.
No booking disappears.
No confirmed booking becomes cancelled.
First minimize table-set changes.
Pair input order cannot count as a seating change.
Then minimize unused seats over ALL considered bookings, including unmoved ones.
Then minimize rank vector in ascending reference order.
Singles rank first in fixture order starting zero.
Pairs rank next in declaration order.
Returned pair members use declaration order.
Plan ID obeys opaque ID contract.
Returned closure represents submitted exact interval.
Assignments are in reference order.
unused_seats equals accepted-capacity sum minus party over all considered bookings.
Successful preview stores a replayable/applicable plan.
Preview publishes no closure.
Preview alters no occupancy.
Preview writes no history.
Preview changes no reservation revision.
Preview changes no restaurant revision.
Preview changes no series revision.
No feasible assignment returns 409 no_feasible_plan.
A valid interval without considered bookings supports an empty plan.
Support six tables.
Support four declared pairs.
Support six considered bookings.
Larger inputs may succeed correctly or return 422 planning_limit; an in-bound infeasible problem must not be labelled planning_limit.
Unknown fields do not invalidate preview but remain part of complete retry identity.
Fixture manager can apply.
No bearer receives 401 unauthenticated.
Nonmanager receives 403 forbidden.
Unknown plan receives 404 not_found.
An applied plan remains plan_already_applied under a fresh key after later restaurant revisions.
Application returns original plan_id.
Reservations include all considered bookings, including unmoved ones.
Reservations are in reference order.
Closure and all assignments commit together.
Reassigned stores unchanged complete accepted_terms.
Reassigned sequence follows the previous history contiguously.
Unmoved reservation revision is unchanged.
Unmoved history is unchanged.
Accepted terms do not adopt newer policies.
Writes/closures at another restaurant do not invalidate this plan.
A refused application key remains reusable.
Unknown body fields are ignored and retain full retry identity.
Applied closure excludes overlapping singles.
Applied closure excludes pairs with any closed member.
Other members and adjacent intervals remain available according to capacity/occupancy.
Pair create intersecting any closed member is refused.
Real amendment intersecting a closure returns 409 table_unavailable without mutation.
Collective moves obey closures atomically.
Generated series occurrences obey closures atomically.
Series amendment obeys closures atomically.
Capacity remains independently evaluated when a closure also excludes the table.
A capacity and closure refusal reports both false.
No explanation appears when omitted.
Original successful receipts are unchanged by a closure.
Closures and saved plans survive unchanged export/import.
Each successful new booking increments once.
Each real individual amendment increments once.
First cancellation increments once.
First successful policy publication increments once.
A real collective batch increments once regardless of member count.
Series adoption increments once including all generated bookings.
Real series amendment increments once.
Application increments once even with zero moved bookings.
Empty eligible amendment does not increment.
Preview does not increment.
Every refused write does not increment.
Every successful replay does not increment.
Owner can amend series.
Unknown series receives 404 not_found.
Manager receives no private access to another diner series.
expected_revision is required.
from_index is required.
local_time is required.
Unknown fields ignored for validation.
Only indices at or after from_index are considered.
Cancelled exceptional members remain excluded.
Every owner remains.
Every party size remains.
Identical resulting fields are a no-op.
Real change checks old accepted cutoff first.
Real change adopts the resulting scheduled date policy.
Real change validates all resulting fields including retained tables/party under new terms.
Real change recalculates absolute end using new duration.
Result cannot conflict with unchanged members.
Result cannot conflict with other bookings.
Result cannot conflict with applied closures.
First nonoccupancy error in eligible index order wins before overlap.
Otherwise any overlap is table_unavailable.
Failure preserves all reservation records.
Failure preserves all histories.
Failure leaves key reusable and existing successful receipts unchanged.
Successful response is the complete current series shape.
Each changed member records one ordinary changed event with exact ordered fields.
Restaurant increments once if any member changed.
Empty eligible succeeds with unchanged revisions/history/terms.
Nonexistent resulting local time rejects whole transaction.
Repeated resulting local time uses first occurrence.
Valid original dates across month/year/leap boundaries remain exact.
Repair preserves every existing exception flag.
Repair preserves every original scheduled date.
Repair preserves occurrence references/indices/reservation identities.
Repair preserves complete accepted terms and times.
Each affected series increments once per plan regardless of moved member count.
A series with no moved member does not increment.
Each of several affected series increments once.
Subsequent collective amendment uses repaired current seats and original schedule while skipping exceptions/cancelled.
Concurrent different plans based on same restaurant revision cannot partially commit both.
Concurrent real amendments using one expected series revision cannot both change.
Concurrent plan application and create admit a serial ordering with occupancy/revisions intact.
Concurrent plan application and individual/series amendment admit complete serial states.
Concurrent policy publication and apply observe stale-plan serialization.
Concurrent lookup/list/series/explain observations are complete valid states.
Atomic exports captured during changes represent complete pre/post generations and receipts.
Unchanged captured exports import to independent peers and preserve entire generations.
Competing failures retain key reusability.
Preserve genuine legacy Stage1 receipt numeric meanings and strings.
Preserve genuine legacy Stage2 pair/single receipt shape independently of profile.
Preserve hashes and password login.
Existing source tokens remain usable.
Identities/references/status/timestamps remain exact.
Actual existing immutable terms/history retained.
Moved/exception/cancelled imported occurrences retain flags and history.
Writes after capture do not alter captured replacement.
Repeated replacement restores without duplication.
Invalid new private-state plan/closure/series relationships reject atomically.
Reset clears all imported state and credentials.
Actual fixture manager can preview/apply through visible controls.
Actual nonmanager is refused without fabricated capability.
Preview displays proposed assignments separately from committed reservations.
Diner current lookup remains unchanged before application.
Successful application displays actual authoritative current assignments.
Stale refusal remains visibly unapplied.
Infeasible refusal remains visibly unapplied.
No optimistic success is shown before server evidence.
Current diner confirmation uses current view separately from immutable successful create receipt.
Owned lookup reflects applied seating and reassigned history with unchanged terms.
Refusal wording is truthful for both closures and bookings.
Actual owner submits expected_revision/from_index/local_time through visible controls.
Result distinguishes changed/unchanged/cancelled/exception members with stable references.
Failure never implies partial commit.
Commit-then-drop apply stays uncertain and unchanged retry recovers actual receipt.
Commit-then-drop series amend stays uncertain and unchanged retry recovers actual receipt.
Malformed committed response cannot manufacture success.
Real field edit changes request identity.
Unchanged retry retains exact body/key.
Delayed earlier preview cannot replace a newer preview/selection.
Delayed series state cannot replace newer agreement/result.
Required real flows usable at 375 CSS pixels without horizontal scroll.
Required real flows usable at conventional desktop width.
Actual Tab/Enter/focus flows complete preview/apply/amend/recovery.
Human restaurant/table labels remain prominent including combinations.
Text/control contrast and visible focus remain sufficient.
Logout clears private manager/diner history/series views.
Manager cannot reveal another diner terms/history/series.
All assets/routes/scripts/styles work without outbound services.
Same document/form/user/body/key survives genuine earlier-source import and lost-response retry.
